limits_and_open_decisions.detail: Sector percentages and normalized speed/memory values have no supplied benchmark corpus. The handoff says they came from original infographics and prior removal of editorial notes was deliberate. Values were preserved; they must not be presented as newly measured evidence.

The original 199343-row estimate vs stated100000/50000-row fixture and the possible_keys=NULL panel cannot be reproduced against the original MySQL9.7.2 server. Generic index behavior was checked on26.7.0; exact historical estimates/timings were preserved rather than invented.
Independent fixture provenance is now explicit. Original file sizes, space IDs, process IDs and datasets are unavailable and remain historical snapshots.
Student Pack/Rider approval deadlines and grading requirements are instructor policy; technical CLI independence is demonstrated without changing those weights or deadlines.
Block A is covered by the brief but receives no separate rubric row. Existing weights were preserved; integration in the graded technical tasks requires instructor interpretation.

No MSVC/Visual Studio Windows execution was performed. Compiler diagnostic numbers were verified via .NET10 or clang where possible; Windows shell exit codes, machine performance and original server timestamps were not remeasured.
